All of our escape rooms in NYC are 100% private. When you book a game at Escape Room Madness, the room is reserved exclusively for you and your group—no strangers are added to your booking. This makes our Manhattan escape rooms perfect for couples, families, friends, birthdays, and corporate team-building events.

Our escape room games in NYC are 60 minutes long. We ask that your group arrive about 15 minutes early for check-in and a brief introduction. Plan for about 90 minutes total from arrival to departure so you have time for photos and questions after your game.
